Thanks — apologies for the short notice.

Vanessa — quick update after pulling the marketplace metering export and talking to infra:

- Our ingest pipeline does a partner_id normalization step (legacy partner aliases are mapped to canonical ids). I confirmed CloudMerchant is present in our internal metering table as partner canonical id "cm-429" and we do not appear to rewrite that to any other id at export time.
- However, I found ~1,200 lines in the raw export where the SKU tags were missing the partner alias metadata — those lines are exported with null partner_id in the CSV that goes to GCP. That matches CloudMerchant's observation that certain SKUs are missing from GCP's settlement.
- Likely root cause: a batch job failure on 2026-05-31 that reprocessed metering logs and dropped the partner alias column for some events. The job's retry logic didn't repopulate alias metadata for events > 30s late. We're working on a patch.

Next steps I recommend:
1) Regenerate the corrected metering export for May and prepare a replacement settlement file for GCP. I estimate A) regenerate & validate: 8 hours, B) staging upload prep & docs: 2 hours.
2) We'll draft a short explanatory note for GCP to attach to CloudMerchant's case (we should include file checksums and a list of affected SKUs).
3) If GCP accepts the replacement file, they usually apply a correction within one settlement cycle (7–14 days). In parallel, finance (Sean) can evaluate a temporary credit.

I'll start the regeneration job now and will post the output to the Drive folder (link to follow).

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
